_note: Experiment manifest TEMPLATE for H0005, frozen 2026-07-21 by PREREG-20260721-H0005-calibration.md. Every value below is a placeholder to be filled in ONLY at execution time, exactly as this template specifies -- no key may be added, removed, or renamed after results are seen (RESEARCH.md 'Standard experiment protocol', step 6/8). Copy this file to EXP-<execution-date>-H0005-calibration-results.json and fill it in.

dataset.version: <TO_BE_FILLED: dataset build version label used, e.g. exp-<date>-h0005>
dataset.git_commit: <TO_BE_FILLED: git commit of the dataset-build + analysis code actually run>

config.mid_price_rounding: round_half_up (X.5 rounds up to X+1), per AMENDMENT-20260721-H0005-pre-execution.md Finding 5
config.outcome_derivation: settlement/labels.py implied_result(value_at_settlement, strike_type, floor_strike, cap_strike); requires settlement_label_status == 'resolved'
config.rng_consumption_order: single random.Random(20260721); discovery-slice cells (horizon ascending [2,6,12,24,48,72] outer, decile ascending inner, 60 calls) then hold-out-slice cells, same nested order, unconditional for all 60 cells (120 calls total); no other statistic consumes randomness -- AMENDMENT Finding 3
config.bootstrap_pool_separation: discovery bootstrap resamples only discovery-slice days; holdout bootstrap resamples only holdout-slice days; pools never mixed -- AMENDMENT Finding 2
config.replication_split: chronological halves of the valid-day population, 1-day embargo at the boundary
config.split_tie_break: if the post-embargo day count is odd, discovery slice receives the extra (earliest) day -- AMENDMENT Finding 8
config.evaluation_order: 1) total-day floor -> inconclusive; 2) any cell clears both screens -> rejected; 3) any discovery-passing cell insufficient_n in holdout -> inconclusive-for-power; 4) otherwise confirmed -- AMENDMENT Finding 4
config.empty_cell_handling: N=0 cell: calibration_error null, excluded from ECE weighted sum, contributes zero rows to regression -- AMENDMENT Finding 7
config.close_time_immutability_verified: <TO_BE_FILLED: true/false -- AMENDMENT Finding 6, blocking pre-execution checklist item, do not proceed with dataset build until this is recorded>
config.duplicate_invariants_checked: <TO_BE_FILLED: true/false -- AMENDMENT Finding 9, one row per (market_ticker, horizon) and candle natural-key uniqueness, asserted before any bucket assignment>

primary_results.cells: <TO_BE_FILLED: array of 60 objects, one per (horizon, decile), computed unconditionally in both slices per AMENDMENT Finding 3: {horizon_hours, decile, n_days_discovery, n_days_holdout, mean_predicted_probability, realized_yes_frequency, calibration_error, cost_band_cents, discovery_ci95, discovery_bonferroni_pass, holdout_ci95, holdout_pass, insufficient_n}>
primary_results.cells_rejecting_null: <TO_BE_FILLED: list of (horizon, decile) pairs clearing both screens>

decision_rule.confirmed_if: no primary-family cell clears both the Bonferroni-adjusted discovery-slice screen and the hold-out replication screen
decision_rule.rejected_if: at least one primary-family cell clears both screens
decision_rule.inconclusive_if: settlement_days_available < 60, OR every discovery-screen-passing cell falls below min_days_per_cell in the holdout slice

secondary_results.executable_price_robustness: <TO_BE_FILLED: for each cell in cells_rejecting_null, ask-implied and bid-implied recomputation>

exploratory_results.kxlowtnyc_cell: <TO_BE_FILLED: same metric shape as primary_results, NOT used for the primary decision>
exploratory_results.by_month_descriptive: <TO_BE_FILLED: descriptive only, never used to select a favorable period>
